global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, dark broth with tender noodles, topped generously with chopped green onions and a halved soft-boiled egg. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden tray under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red-brown geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with chopped green onions, appears rich, dark brown, and glossy with visible noodle strands and green flecks.
regions.spoon: A glossy, reddish-brown wooden spoon with smooth, curved surface and tapered handle.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg reveals a runny, orange-red yolk surrounded by firm white, with a glossy surface.
